details:
`*.twitch.tv` is on the [video player allowlist](https://creators.vrchat.com/worlds/udon/video-players/www-whitelist/), but clips from the same Twitch domain cannot be played without allowing untrusted URLs. I believe this is unintended.

What works:

- Live streams on Twitch.tv (`*.ttvnw.net`), for example https://www.twitch.tv/vrchat

- Twitch VODs (`d2nvs31859zcd8.cloudfront.net`), for example from https://www.twitch.tv/vrchat/videos

What doesn't work:

- Twitch clips (`d1ndex63qxojbr.cloudfront.net`), for example from https://www.twitch.tv/vrchat/clips

Steps to reproduce:

1. Pick a Twitch video clip from https://www.twitch.tv/vrchat/clips and copy the URL of the video clip of your choice.

2. Launch VRChat, join a private instance (Friends+).

3. Navigate to VRChat settings in-client and make sure "Allow Untrusted URLs" setting is off in Comfort & Safety Settings.

4. Play the chosen Twitch clips URL (https://www.twitch.tv/vrchat/clip/HeartlessCrispyZebraSeemsGood-ewpkUK0lnSYLyIuJ) in VRChat in a video player, from a private instance.

5. Notice the playback fails.

6. Allow Untrusted URLs in the Comfort & Safety Settings.

7. Play the Twitch clip URL from step 4 again.

8. Notice the playback succeeds.

Expected result: Twitch clips should play without untrusted URLs, because they're functionally the same as allowlisted VODs the clips come from and because the parent origin domain is already allowlisted.

Actual result: The `d1ndex63qxojbr.cloudfront.net` domain for Twitch Clips is missing from the video player allowlist (fetched from https://api.vrchat.cloud/api/1/config), and the video playback fails when the user has disabled "Allow Untrusted URLs" in VRChat (which is also the default setting). It also means Twitch Clips can never be played in public instances currently.

Additional info:

- `[Video Playback] URL not allowed` appears in logs with "Allow Untrusted URLs" off when Twitch clips are played.

- yt-dlp `2026.08.19` from VRChat was used for testing.
title: Twitch Clips cannot be played without allowing untrusted URLs; d1ndex63qxojbr.cloudfront.net domain is missing from the video player allowlist
